card.name: Sentence end after NSAID renal warnings
card.fires_on: The period (or a sentence-opening "In") ending a warning about NSAID-related kidney or GI harm, such as deterioration of renal function or renal decompensation. It appears in NSAID and ACE inhibitor or ARB interaction warnings.

modes.label: Period after renal harm
modes.description: The full stop after a phrase like acute renal failure or overt renal decompensation.
modes.example: including possible acute renal failure<<.>> These effects are usually reversible.

modes.label: Sentence-opening In
modes.description: The word In starting a sentence about high-risk patients right after a renal warning.
modes.example: may result in deterioration of renal function.<< In>> such high risk patients, monitor for signs

modes.label: Period after GI bleeding warning
modes.description: The full stop after a line about watching for GI ulceration and bleeding during NSAID therapy.
